nary_nodes.label: Rumoured wedding celebrations
evidence: Taylor Swift and her American football-player fiancé Travis Kelce have kicked off rumoured wedding celebrations at Madison Square Garden in New York City.
Media speculation has dubbed the event both a pre-party and possible rehearsal dinner.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Wedding celebrations are events; no specific type.

nary_nodes.label: Pre-party night
evidence: A permit for the events on Thursday and Friday obtained by the Associated Press said about 100 guests would start arriving around 17:30 ET for a "pre-party night", which would go until 22:30 ET.
nary_nodes.type_justification: A pre-party is a social event.

nary_nodes.label: Main ceremony
evidence: Guests at the wedding will reportedly not be allowed to have their phones during the main ceremony, which is expected to begin with mid-afternoon cocktails before a reception going into the night.
nary_nodes.type_justification: A wedding ceremony is an event; no specific type.

nary_nodes.label: Donation to charities
evidence: On Thursday evening, the couple donated $26m (£19.4m) to charities in the US close to their hearts, including organisations in New York, Nashville, where Swift started her music career and Kansas City, the home of Kelce's NFL team.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Donation is an event; no specific type.

nary_nodes.label: Media coverage of event
evidence: Throughout the day on Thursday, a small army of cops sweated it out in asphalt-curdling heat while camera crews tried to catch a glimpse of anything that would confirm what was happening inside the arena, which is home to multiple sports teams in the city.

Celebrity gossip outlet TMZ fired up a live feed of what appeared to be one of the Garden's loading bays, where for several hours one could watch stationary forklifts and the occasional event staffer sneaking a cigarette.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Media coverage is a publication event.

nary_nodes.label: Street closures
evidence: City officials confirmed to the BBC that somebody applied for street closure permits in the area, but did not reveal whom.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Street closures are events; no specific type.

nary_nodes.label: Fans gather outside
evidence: Fans gathered outside, even after their mayor explicitly and repeatedly told them to please stay inside on a day when temperatures topped 100F (37C).
nary_nodes.type_justification: Fan gathering is an event; no specific type.

nary_nodes.label: Celebrities arrive
evidence: Paparazzi captured images of Antonoff, Swift's longtime producer, sporting a tux and a toothpick dangling out of his mouth, reportedly heading to Thursday's event at the Garden.
His sister Rachel Antonoff, a designer, followed closely behind in a bubblegum-pink dress.
Famed American sports broadcaster Erin Andrews was also seen in a silver sparkly gown and Swift's longtime publicist, Tree Paine, wore a light blue dress.
US tabloid Page Six reported Bradley Cooper and Gigi Hadid, a longtime member of Swift's friend circle, had also arrived at the venue.
Pop star and actress Selena Gomez posted images of herself on Instagram wearing a black gown with gem earrings and heading to an unspecified event.
People Magazine published a video of Dunham, who created the series Girls, being chauffeured through Manhattan in a black SUV.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Arrivals are events; no specific type.

nary_nodes.label: Swift leaves event
evidence: Swift reportedly left Thursday night's event at Madison Square Garden well after midnight, arriving home in the early hours of Friday morning.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Departure is an event; no specific type.

nary_nodes.label: Donation for charities
evidence: Swift's representatives, while not mentioning anything about a wedding, told BBC News the donation which included food banks, was for "charities across the United States".

evidence: Media speculation has dubbed the event both a pre-party and possible rehearsal dinner.

nary_nodes.label: No phones at ceremony
evidence: Guests at the wedding will reportedly not be allowed to have their phones during the main ceremony, which is expected to begin with mid-afternoon cocktails before a reception going into the night.

evidence: Laura Bonne, a 20 year old tourist visiting from Belgium who was waiting outside the Garden, praised Swift's decision on the venue. "I think its nice because she'll have a lot of privacy."
